summary: The proposed patch does not address the root cause of the issue and may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The patch changes the condition from checking if `__all__` is empty to checking if it is `None`. This may break existing behavior where an empty `__all__` is intended to exclude all members.
There are no tests provided to verify the correctness of the change, making it difficult to ensure that the fix works as expected in different scenarios.
